messages:
Nina P.: Noticed a small set of duplicate NetSuite invoices tied to the same Stripe invoice id after yesterday's webhook spike. Putting logs here.

Nina P.: ```log
2026-04-05T22:10:12Z stripe-webhook evt=invoice.finalized id=in_7Aa
2026-04-05T22:10:12Z reconciler create external_ref=stripe:invoice:in_7Aa status=201 ns=NSINV-9001
2026-04-05T22:10:13Z stripe-webhook evt=invoice.updated id=in_7Aa metadata:update_reason=proration
2026-04-05T22:10:13Z reconciler create external_ref=stripe:invoice:in_7Aa:suffix status=201 ns=NSINV-9002
```

Raj S.: Looks like reconciler sometimes appends a suffix when it sees metadata.update_reason. That breaks our dedupe because create path A and B use different external_ref. Bug introduced in reconciler v2.14.

Lena A.: Accounting will want the later NS ids voided and an audit memo. Please open ACCT ticket with mapping: stripe invoice -> NS ids, and suggested memo text.

billing-bot: Created ACCT-2201: Duplicate NS invoices from reconciler due to webhook ordering.

Nina P.: Proposed fix: normalize external_ref to stripe:invoice:{invoice.id} across all code paths. Also add idempotency query by that exact key before create. Backfill: find stripe:invoice ids with >1 NS invoice and output CSV for ACCT-2201.

Raj S.: Added a short-term guard to drop suffixes and a metric if reconciler issues >1 create for same stripe:invoice within 1h. Will open PR and run in staging tonight.

Lena A.: Once ACCT-2201 has the CSV we'll void and add memo: "automated duplicate from reconciler (webhook ordering)". Please CC me on the PR.

Nina P.: Will re-run daily_revenue_job for affected dates after voids. I'll update this thread when prod deploy + backfill complete. :thumbsup:
